messages:
Alex: Quick exec Friday note — priorities for next week, a couple of policy updates, and APAC Private beta timing. Please add blockers before Monday EOD.

Priya: SLO proposal: target P95 latency 180ms for hosted text-gen core routes. We'll need a perf matrix run + kernel microbench. Spinning up perf harness today. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/perf-harness/pull/849

Marco: Product ok for a 72h soft canary for APAC Private partners. Need comms draft + partner checklist by Mon. I'll drop a template in #product-docs.

Rina: Ops plan — apac-prod infra apply this weekend, smoke + staged ramp. New canary plan: 3 stages (3% -> 25% -> 100%) with metric gates. Sam please watch KV eviction and OOM trends closely.

Sam: Oncall covering Saturday night. Running synthetic suite against /v1/generate and /v1/chat, will stream logs to #eng-oncall and attach short dashboard GIF after the first window.

Daniel: Policy update pushed: default customer payload retention 30 days, support staff access limited by RBAC, and KMS key rotation every 60 days for Private installs. Filing follow-ups to update onboarding flows and Okta groups: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-2134

Tess: Partner Beta A confirmed Monday morning (limited seats). Legal signed DPA addendum yesterday. Compliance flagged nothing blocking.

Alex: Quick metrics snapshot: quantization + batching reduced cost per 1M tokens ~5.8% month-over-month; 7d success rate 99.92% — still chasing the tail errors. Three ops asks: (1) shorten canary rollback time to <30m, (2) finalize APAC runbook and checklist, (3) update public SLA wording to reflect new SLOs. I'll post PR templates for comms and SLA language.

Marco: For public SLA language — prefer outcome-oriented phrasing, avoid numerical penalty examples. Internal SLA appendix will contain details & credits table. Draft internal copy at https://docs.redwood.com/internal/sla/apac-v1

Rina: Runbook excerpt for visibility:
```
APAC Private rollout (UTC):
- 02:30: infra apply (helm + k8s templates)
- 03:30: start canary (3%)
- 05:00: evaluate metrics (P95, error rate, KV miss, GPU stalls)
- 06:00: scale to 25% if green
- 08:00: final checks, open to partners
Rollback: flip traffic to fallback pool + revert config. Target full rollback <30m.
```

deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment: apac-private-templates v2.4 -> apac-prod at 2026-04-11T02:30:00Z; requested by @rina

Sam: I'll attach the synthetic run screenshot and a tiny perf GIF after the first canary window. If memory/GPU stalls appear I'll escalate immediately.

Daniel: Note: telemetry rules — redact any raw customer payloads before long-term retention. I'll post the logging redaction snippet and pipeline change set in #eng-infra.

Alex: Thanks all. Action items: Priya — perf runs + kernel tuning; Rina — finalize runbook + rollback timing; Marco — partner comms + SLA draft; Daniel — telemetry redaction + Okta/KMS tickets; Sam — oncall + synthetics. Short all-hands Tuesday 10:00 PT for a launch demo + exec Q&A. :rocket:
